fields.why: The claims rest on each person's BLLs tracked across many successive tests (a multi-period series), so group fits best; the BLRV is a case-defining cutpoint, which the brief excludes as a comparison, though the text also sets BLLs against DOHMH's intervention level and <5 μg/dL, making fixed referent defensible.

brief_issues: The brief does not say how to frame a single case series followed over many time points, where values are also judged against changing action thresholds; a rule that within-person serial values count as a period comparison (pair for 2, group for 3+) would decide it.
